data.name: Elvina
data.gender_notes: Elvina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Elvina is derived from the European name Elvina, which is of uncertain origin. However, it is believed to mean 'gentle' or 'beautiful' in various European languages. In the Islamic context, this name does not have any specific religious or Quranic significance. The name Elvina carries the meaning “Gentle, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Elvina usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Elvina is a name that carries the energy of strength, resilience, and determination. It is a reminder that even the most challenging obstacles can be overcome with perseverance and grace. This name is ideal for parents who want to instill these qualities in their child from an early age.
data.etymology: Elvina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elvina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: الفي

In this case, the name Elvina is a name derived from the story of a Muslim woman who had a great character in Islam due to her sincerity in faith and reform in life.
